items.title: Eli Lilly continues genetic medicine push with $1.9bn Ascidian partnership
items.summary: Eli Lilly’s deal with Ascidian is one of several that the pharma giant has cut within the realm of genetic medicines.

items.title: Cellares and TScan to assess automated manufacturing of TSC-101 therapy
items.summary: Cellares and TScan Therapeutics have entered a deal to assess automated manufacturing for TScan’s TSC-101 therapy in AML and MDS patients.

items.title: Regeneron and CytomX extend cancer therapy partnership to $4bn deal
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals and CytomX have expanded their research and licensing partnership to develop conditionally activated bispecific antibody cancer therapies.

items.title: US lawmakers reveal policy to curb collaboration with Chinese biotech
items.summary: If enacted, BINSA would give lawmakers the right to monitor and restrict American companies from signing biotech and pharma-focused deals with Chinese entities.

items.title: Contraline secures $92.5m to push male contraceptive into late-stage trials
items.summary: Contraline could become the first to commercialise a reversible male contraceptive drug, provided the treatment is successful in Phase III.
